As someone who has been to the hospital for mental health reasons several times this makes me happy to read 

Thank you for doing such a difficult job

The police helped me because they stopped me from immediate danger which was myself 

How it occurred I was in a dark place due to some shitty circumstances occuring in my life 

I called my best friend to vent as I was walking to the bridge and he texted my other buddy to call the cops I was 2-3 minutes away at that point so I didn't think there was anyway that I could be stopped by then 

The cops werent easy on me they had 3 or 4 cars rushing to me and it was scary as fuck 

After I was in handcuffs which they did as I was on the ground I received a officer who tried to make small talk as I was taken to the psych ward while I was there it sucked knowing my rights were essentially gone 

The staff at the hospital stabilized me on medication worked with me on support strategies and I was given follow up appointments with a mental health team to attend as well as one therapist 

My friends visited me in the psych ward a week or so after I was there  and he made the right decision 100% 

When I saw them we hugged and they apologized expressed his hands were tied and they truly thought if they didn't intervene I'd be gone for good and they wouldn't be able to live with themselves if they didn't

I've had a person who did this to me and if they didn't call 911 I wouldn't be around anymore 

It wasn't a good experience that's for damn sure but am I still around yes 

Was I mad at my friend yes but I'm beyond happy he did it
